name: productsgroup-read
description: A product group list retrieval skill based on the Tradebee Website Builder Open API. It is used to obtain published product category/group data from the website. It supports filtering by language and parent product group, multi-level group hierarchy retrieval, and is suitable for product category display, navigation generation, data analysis, AI content generation, SEO optimization, intelligent retrieval, and similar scenarios.

language.description: Required. It must be selected from `languages-get` after user confirmation. Automatic selection or system inference is not allowed.

parent_productsgroup_id.description: Optional. Parent product group ID. Omit this field or set `0` to read top-level groups. If provided as a positive integer (`> 0`), the API returns the direct child groups under that parent group. `parent_productsgroup_id` and `productsgroup_id` are mutually exclusive: omit both to read top-level groups, or provide exactly one of them.

productsgroup_id.description: Optional. Exact product group filter. Omit this field to avoid exact-group filtering. If provided, it must be one positive integer (`> 0`). `parent_productsgroup_id` and `productsgroup_id` are mutually exclusive: omit both to read top-level groups, or provide exactly one of them.

fields.description: Optional. Field selection list. If omitted, all supported product group fields are returned. When returning a list to the user, include `productsgroup_id` and `productsgroup_url` so one ID and one preview URL are available in the final answer. Do not tell the user they must preview it; provide the preview URL so the user can decide.

status.description: Request status. `true` indicates success and `false` indicates failure.

data.description: Returned result, which may be `null` on failure

seo.description: Optimization data for the product group page, including title, description, and keywords

keywords.description: Optimized keywords, up to 6 keywords separated by commas, with a total length <= 120 characters

section.description: Custom HTML decoration fragments for the product group page body.

top.description: Product group page header decoration fragment. HTML fragment only.

bottom.description: Product group page footer decoration fragment. HTML fragment only.

productsgroup_url.description: Product group URL. When the response is a list, use one returned `productsgroup_url` as the preview URL in the final answer so the user can decide whether to preview it.

create_time.description: Creation time in ISO 8601 date-time format

update_time.description: Update time in ISO 8601 date-time format

is_leaf.description: Whether this is a leaf node. `true` means yes and `false` means no.

children.description: List of child groups, supporting recursive nesting
